shortDescription: A modern overhaul of RimWorld's dev tools: a debug log that traces errors to the culprit mod and explains them, hosts HugsLib's and Archotech Logs' log-window buttons in a suite-styled add-on tray, and can throttle runaway log spam. Plus a knowledge-base browser, in-game bug/fix reporting, a 3-tab dev actions window and reskinned palette, impact scoring, updated-mod tracking, and a public v2 API for other mods.
body:
## Modern Dev Tools

A modern overhaul of RimWorld's developer tools (Modern Suite). Namespace `ModernDevTools`, assembly `ModernDevTools.dll`, packageId `astryl.ModernDevTools`. C# + Harmony. Open source (MIT). **Version constant now `1.3`; v1.2 is what is live on the Workshop.**

### Shared UI (`Palette`)
Dark suite chrome, sentence case, ASCII, cached Theme.Accent, flat gray scrollbars. `GameFont.Tiny` banned suite-wide except the dev palette's category line. Icons in `Textures/UI/DevTools/` via `MdtTex`. Helpers: `SearchField`, `ToggleRow`/`ToggleRowHeight`, `DrawCard`/`DrawWell`/`DrawPlate`, `SectionHeader`, `DrawToggle`, `DrawCheck`, `ModuleRow`, `GrayButton`, `StateStrip`, `LabelFit`, `BeginScroll`/`EndScroll`/`ResetGuiState`.
- Never scale text with `GUI.matrix` inside a `Window`. Size rects from `Text.LineHeightOf(font)`.
- **`DrawPlate` (2-draw card):** border colour as one filled rect + fill inset 1px = 2 `GUI.DrawTexture` instead of 5. **Gated to `Prefs.UIScale == 1f`**, where `UIScaling.AdjustRectToUIScaling` reduces to floor/ceil so it is provably pixel-identical; fractional scales keep vanilla's per-edge snapping. *Unverified at 125/150% — the gate means no risk shipped, but the win doesn't apply there either.*
- **`BeginScroll` is re-entrant** (skin styles on a STACK, because `ErrorModule.DrawSection` runs inside the inspector's live scroll view). `ResetGuiState()` unwinds strays; called from every window `finally`. All 11 scroll sites are in try/finally.

### `TextMetrics`
Memoised `Text.CalcHeight`/`CalcSize`, keyed on (text, rounded width, resolved GameFont, that style's fontSize, WordWrap). `Text.Font`'s getter returns the *coerced* font (Tiny→Small when `TinyFontSupported` is false), so an accessibility change can't serve a stale metric. Cap-then-clear at 8192. **Main thread only** (documented, not locked). Every measurement site routes through it.

### Tool 1: modern debug log (`Window_ModernLog`)
Redirects `UIRoot.CheckOpenLogWindow` + `DebugWindowsOpener.ToggleLogWindow`, **gated on `LogWindowCompat.ModernOwnsLog`**. List (culled) + inspector + **add-on tray**.
- Toolbar B is a right-to-left cursor (`RightButton`): Clear, Copy all, Modules, Update info, Knowledge base, **Vanilla log** (only when a decorator is detected), search fills the rest.
- Compat hint strip, **frame-latched** (`_hintFrame`) — its own Dismiss button flips the setting that hides it, so reading live would drop a control between OnGUI passes and shift later IMGUI ids.
- Repeat chip shows `x{repeats}+{suppressed}` in Warn colour when the throttle held repeats back.

### Log-window ownership + interop — the biggest correctness issue this mod had
**Problem:** replacing the vanilla log silently deleted other mods' UI, with no error. Detected by TYPE presence (what matters is whether the decorating code loaded), not packageId.
- **HugsLib** — `HugsLib.Logs.LogWindowExtensions.AddLogWindowWidget(WidgetDrawer, WidgetAlignMode)` is the community-standard hook, rendered by a prefix on `EditWindow_Log.DoMessagesListing`. It registers *Share logs* (LogPublisher), *Files*, *Copy*; any mod may add more. All of it vanished.
- **Archotech Logs** — Diagnostics/Export/colour-toggle postfixes on `EditWindow_Log.DoWindowContents`; its main-button worker calls `new EditWindow_Log()` directly, bypassing our patches → a second divergent window.

**Shipped:** `yieldLogWindow` setting (full stand-down), "Vanilla log" button, one-time hint strip, and **`LogWidgets`** — reflects HugsLib's private `widgets` list and rebinds each `Drawer` via `Delegate.CreateDelegate` to our identically-shaped `LogWidgetDrawer` (NOT `DynamicInvoke` — that would pay reflection cost per widget per pass). Drawn in a recessed-well tray. Throwing widgets are dropped, as HugsLib does. `LogWidgets.Any` is **frame-latched** (the tray sizes the body rect; a mid-frame flip would resize the list and shift ids).
**Tray restyle:** an on-demand prefix on the 7-arg `Widgets.ButtonText` funnel, gated on `LogWidgets.Drawing`, re-skins hosted buttons into suite gray. Control-count safe (vanilla's `ButtonTextWorker` emits exactly one `ButtonInvisible` when active, none when inactive — same as `Palette.GrayButton`). Honours `drawBackground:false` (bare text link) by falling through, preserves the mouseover sound, and fails open.

### `ArchotechBridge`
Hosts Archotech's Diagnostics + Export windows as tray buttons. Two facts the decompile settled:
1. `Dialog_ArchotechInfoView(EditWindow_Log)` uses the host **only for positioning**, and BOTH consumers null-check it (`PreOpen` centres, `WindowUpdate` early-returns). **Passing null is a supported path** — no dummy `EditWindow_Log` needed. (Earlier estimate of 45% was too pessimistic; this is ~92.)
2. Its `DoWindowContents` reads `EditWindow_Log.selectedMessage` — a private **static** — not its host window. So `LogState.Selected` is now a property raising `SelectionChanged`, which `ArchotechBridge` subscribes to and mirrors into that static. Without the mirror the dialog always reports "no log selected". Good citizenship for any other mod reading the same field.

### `LogThrottle` — optional suppression of repeating log lines (default OFF)
**Engine facts:** `Log.Error/Warning/Message` evaluate `StackTraceUtility.ExtractStackTrace()` as an ARGUMENT, i.e. *before* `Enqueue` can notice a repeat; repeat cap is 99 and below it every occurrence also does a synchronous `Debug.Log*` disk write; all inside `lock(logLock)`. **The gap:** `LogMessageQueue` only combines with `lastMessage`, so dedupe is strictly *consecutive* — interleaved spam (A,B,A,B) never combines, never caps, never stops writing.
**Design:** allocation-free FNV-1a + 64-slot ring; first `Threshold`(5) always pass; 10s quiet window resets; `Environment.TickCount` not `Time.frameCount` (`Log.Error` can be called off-thread); own short lock; **fails open** and latches off. Summaries drained from the `Root.Update` hook, never from the prefix (would re-enter `Log`).
**Honesty:** suppressed counts surface in the chip + tooltip, and `ImpactAssessor.EffectiveRepeats` folds them into severity so the throttle can never make an error look milder. `LogAnalysis.Impact` is keyed on the effective count.
**Test actions:** "Log spam x200 (same line)" and **"Log spam x200 (two interleaved lines)"** — the latter is the case vanilla cannot collapse and is the feature's whole justification.

### Impact scoring (`ImpactAssessor`) — location is NOT frequency
Tick/frame signals prove *where*, not *how often*; a perf claim requires recurrence. `RepeatingThreshold=3`, `SpamThreshold=10`. Curated `MaxImpact` caps the level. **"Known issue" badge = `Diagnoses.Any(d => d.FromLibrary)`**, set only by KnownIssues/ModIssues/CommunityBugs. Cached on `LogAnalysis`, keyed on effective repeats.

### `IssueScoring` — ONE matcher for all four knowledge surfaces
Weights (ExceptionType 3 / Regex 3 / Keyword 2 / Namespace 2 / PackageId 2) in one place, shared by the shipped library, mod-shipped `About/known-issues.json`, API-registered sources and the community DB. Keyword tests use allocation-free `OrdinalIgnoreCase` `IndexOf`. `IssueTextUtil` holds the former copy-pasted `StripBom`/`Lower`/`CompileRegexes`/`PairKey`.
- **`RegexOptions.Compiled` deliberately dropped** in the shared compiler (Mono emits IL via Reflection.Emit, never reclaimed; ~100 patterns that now run once per *analysed message*, not per frame). **Reasoned, not measured.** FrameParser's per-line patterns keep it.

### Knowledge-base content & factual-provenance convention — AUDITED 2026-08
**Every match string must be a verbatim engine string, verified against decompiled source, with a `source file:line` provenance comment.** Traps: exact punctuation (`TryMakePreToilReservations()` has parens), keyed-translation indirection ("must be loaded before"), runtime-native strings not in Assembly-CSharp (`wrapper dynamic-method` = Mono, IMGUI = Unity), and messages that don't exist (a missing translation key logs NOTHING). Shipped defs never name a third-party mod; `fix` text is always user-actionable.
- `Defs/KnownIssueDefs.xml` — 44 entries, incl. 4 self-healing vanilla fallbacks (all `ignorable` + `maxImpact=Low`). `MDT_HarmonyConflict` reworded: a single mod's patch produces the same `wrapper dynamic-method` frames, so no conflict claim without ≥2 foreign patchers.
- `Defs/BenignLogDefs.xml` — 5 entries. `Data/community-bugs.json.gz` — 17 entries. Workflow: gunzip → edit plain → `gzip -9` → delete plain.
- Glossary ~26 terms; `AllTerms()` cached (was 52 `.Translate()` + a fresh list, ~3× per pass).

### Analysis modules + extensibility
`ErrorModuleDef`/`ErrorModule`/`ModernDevToolsAPI` + `ErrorContext`. Per module `ContributeAttribution` then `Diagnose`, in `def.order`. 13 modules in flat `Defs/ErrorModules.xml`. `ErrorContext.RankedMods()` cached, invalidated by `Merge` (4 modules foreach `Culprits`, each previously forcing a full 5-key LINQ sort).
- **`Module_ReflectionBridge` + `ReflectionBridgeExtension`:** declarative compat — bind a foreign static type's `Describe(string,string)`/`ImplicatedMod(string,string)` from XML via `modExtensions`. Probe once; silent when absent; **loud `WarningOnce` only on contract drift**; nulls every binding on failure; never `FromLibrary`. Generalises `Module_CircinusCorpus`, which is left in place (verified in-game run #132) rather than migrated.
- `Module_ModIssues` scores mod-shipped files *and* `KnowledgeSources.Pool` as one pool.

### Diagnosis Score scale (house rule)
ModIssues 9+(n−i) > CommunityBugs 8+(n−i) > DependencyCheck 8–8.5 > AboutIncompat 7 > Community 6–7 > HarmonyPatches 4.5–6.5 > VersionMismatch 5 > KnownIssues n−i (benign +1000). Context-only modules (incl. reflection bridges) must score **< 1**.

### Public API v2 (`ModernDevToolsAPI`) — frozen contract
`ApiVersion = 2`. v1: `RegisterModule`, `Invalidate`. v2: `RegisterKnowledgeSource(IKnownIssueSource)`, `RegisterLogWidget(id, drawer, alignRight)`, `AnalysisCompleted` event (once per message, handlers sandboxed), `ModernOwnsLogWindow`, `IsModernLogOpen`, `OpenModernLog()`, `YieldLogWindow()`. Reflection-bindable. `LogWidgetDrawer` is signature-identical to HugsLib's `WidgetDrawer`. Documented in `Documentation/RootCauseAnalysis.md`.

### Settings surfaces — parity contract
`SettingsPage.Draw` is the canonical superset; `Dialog_Modules` is the quick subset. Both share `Palette.ModuleRow` + `SettingsPage.ToggleModule`. Cards: **Log window**, **Log spam**, General, Modules, Ignored, Community, Experimental hardening. The two new cards are settings-page-only (permitted direction). `Documentation/UI-Parity.md`.

### Tool 4: knowledge base (`Window_KnowledgeBase`)
8 categories, searchable, provenance-cited. **Viewport-culled** — `BeginScrollView` clips pixels but doesn't skip draw code, so cards measure (memoised) but skip drawing outside a **frame-latched** window (`UpdateCullWindow`, 300px margin; latched because `BeginScrollView` writes scroll position during the wheel pass). Def counts cached.

### Hardening + `HardeningPatches` (on-demand patching)
`WindowWatchdog` + `UiHardening`, off by default. **All 7 hardening patches, 3 throttle prefixes and the tray restyle install only while their feature is on** — a guard makes the body free but not Harmony's dispatch, and these sit on `Window.WindowOnGUI`, `WindowStack.WindowStackOnGUI`, `Log.Error` and `Widgets.ButtonText`.
**One permanent patch replaces them: a postfix on `Verse.Root.Update`** (both `Root_Entry`/`Root_Play` chain to `base.Update()`), driving `SyncIfNeeded()` + `LogThrottle.DrainSummaries()`. Apply MUST happen there, never from the settings UI, which runs *inside* two of the targets — patching a method on the stack is the one genuinely dangerous use of the runtime API. Failures latch `_broken`. **Validated in-game:** run #221 had all three groups toggled on at runtime with zero errors.

### Community data (opt-in, `CommunityData`)
Background fetch, cached, offline fallback. RimSort Community Rules + Use This Instead + our known-issues.json. `LogAnalysisCache.Clear()` now only raises a volatile `_dirty` flag; the swap happens on the next main-thread read.

### Tools 2/3: dev actions + palette
`Window_ModernDevActions` (3-tab, vanilla node graph, icon-grid spawn pickers, BFS search). `Window_ModernDevPalette` — **resolved nodes cached** against a hash of `Prefs.DebugActionsPalette` (`Dialog_Debug.GetNode` splits the path and runs a capturing-lambda `FirstOrDefault` per segment, previously per pin per frame). Pin/reorder sets `_pendingResizeFrame`, applied at the top of a LATER frame: `ResolveNodes` returns the shared list Draw is iterating, and changing row count mid-frame shifts IMGUI ids.

### Testing / environment note
Silent crashes during testing traced to **ReShade** (`dxgi.dll`), NOT the mod.

## State: 1.3 built, partially verified
In-game runs #221/#222/#223 all returned **zero captured errors**, with HugsLib + Archotech Logs loaded. Confirmed working: HugsLib's Share logs/Files buttons hosted in the tray; compat hint; runtime patch install of all three on-demand groups.
**Still unverified:** (a) the tray restyle to suite gray (built after run #223, never launched); (b) Archotech Diagnostics/Export tray buttons + selection mirroring (never launched); (c) the spam throttle actually suppressing — no spam has occurred yet, the new x200 actions exist for this; (d) **nothing has been profiled**, so phases 2–3 wins remain predicted; (e) 2-draw card at 125/150% UI scale.

## Release / publishing
v1.2 is live: Workshop 3771602203, git `98f6ca6` on `Astryls/ModernDevTools`. 1.3 prepped: version bumped, `MDT_UpdateNotesBody` rewritten, About.xml gained "Plays well with other log mods" + "Optional: throttle log spam" sections and an author-API line (structure + Quality Commitment untouched), `Documentation/UI-Parity.md` updated, RootCauseAnalysis.md gained a full API v2 section.
**Community DB synced:** `_dev/ModernDevTools/community-db/main/known-issues.json` (a staging folder, NOT a git clone) was still the pre-audit copy serving phantom patterns (`nodefinitionfor`, `exceptioninscribe`, `errorwhilerendering`). Regenerated from the audited `Data/community-bugs.json.gz` — 17 entries, JSON validated. **User action: push that folder to `Astryls/ModernDevTools-KnownIssues`** or the opt-in fetch keeps overwriting good local data with bad.

## GitHub Backup
MIT. Mod repo: **https://github.com/Astryls/ModernDevTools** (PUBLIC). Community bug DB (CC0): **https://github.com/Astryls/ModernDevTools-KnownIssues** (PUBLIC). `Source/`, `Assemblies/*.dll`, `.modmixer/`, `Data/community-bugs.json.gz` tracked.
